content: function RecoverFile [SWS_PER_00337] Upstream: RS_PER_00001 , RS_PER_00004 , RS_PER_00009 , RS_AP_00119 , RS_AP_00120 , RS_AP_00121 , RS_AP_00127 , RS_AP_00128 , RS_AP_00129 , RS_AP_00135 , RS_AP_00139 , RS_AP_00159 ara::core::Result < void > RecoverFile ( ara::core::StringView fileName) noexcept; Recovers a file of this File Storage. This method allows to recover a single file when the redundancy checks fail. It will fail with kResourceBusy when the file is currently open. This method does a best-effort recovery of the file. After recovery, the file might show outdated or initial content, or might be lost.
